# Tobiah Ulmford

Tobiah Ulmford is a Pharmaceutical Supply Data Analyst at Nuvix Systems, a leader in real-time temperature monitoring solutions for vaccine shipments. Since joining Nuvix in 2020, Tobiah has specialized in analyzing temperature variance during transit by interpreting large datasets generated from IoT sensor tags embedded in cold-chain shipments.

Before Nuvix, Tobiah spent three years (2017–2020) at CryoLogix Analytics, where he developed foundational expertise in sensor data normalization and anomaly detection. During this time, he contributed to the project ColdTrack, which enhanced cold-chain visibility across multiple pharmaceutical clients.

At Nuvix, Tobiah’s major accomplishment includes spearheading the predictive model project "FrostGuard," which improved cold-chain integrity by 12% by forecasting potential temperature excursions before they occur. This model uses machine learning algorithms trained on historical sensor data coupled with transit route variables.

Tobiah’s working style is data-driven and collaborative; he regularly partners with Nuvix’s logistics coordinators, software engineers, and product managers to translate analytic insights into actionable operational improvements. He is known for his meticulous attention to data quality and his ability to present complex findings in clear, practical terms to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Current employer: [[companies/nuvix-systems]].
